name: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Data Centre
developer: Central Financing and Contracting Department, Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Interior of North Macedonia; EU-funded; designed by 1X2STUDIO, Megaron Engineering and SUEZ Consulting (SAFEGE)
notes: Facility in Municipality of Prilep, Vasko Karangeleski Street, built area 1,307 sqm. 1X2STUDIO lists construction period 03/2018-05/2019 and status built; EU project record documents supervision for establishment of the Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Data Centre.
